title: Phase 3 Study of the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of ALK-001 on the Progression of Stargardt Disease - NORTHSTAR
official: A Phase 3 Multicenter, Double-Masked, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study to Investigate the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of Gildeuretinol Acetate (ALK-001) on the Progression of Stargardt Disease (STGD) - NORTHSTAR
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of ALK-001 compared with placebo in slowing the progression of retinal atrophic lesion growth in participants with STGD
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Age: The person is  between 8 and 45 years old.
2. 2. Diagnosis: The person has been diagnosed with Stargardt Disease (STGD), an inherited eye condition, by an eye doctor.
3. 3. Genetic confirmation:  Genetic test results showing a change in the ABCA4 gene, which is known to cause STGD.
4. 4. Retinal damage In at least one eye: The person must have visible damage to the retina that can be seen on standard eye scans.
5. 5. Disease progression: Eye images show that the disease has worsened over time.
6. 6. Vision level: The person must be able to see large letters during an eye exam.
7. 7. Ability to participate: The participant must be willing and able to understand the study, follow instructions, and complete all required study visits and tests.
8. 8. Pregnancy Prevention:  Women who can become pregnant, and men with partners who can become pregnant, must agree to use birth control during the study and for a short period after the study ends.
9. 9. Consent: The participant (or parent/guardian) must sign the informed consent or assent forms.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Recent vitamin A or retinoid use: Has taken vitamin A supplements, beta-carotene supplements, liver-based products, or prescription retinoid medications (such as isotretinoin/Accutane) within the past 30 days .
2. 2. Pregnancy: A person cannot take part if they are pregnant, breastfeeding, or plan to become pregnant during the study. Men who plan to father a child during the study also cannot take part.
3. 3. Previous STGD clinical studies: Has previously taken part in a clinical study for STGD, unless they received placebo only and had no surgery.
4. 4. Recent participation in other clinical studies: Has recently taken part in another clinical study or plans to take part in other  study during this study.
5. 5. Other medical or eye conditions that could: o affect the eyes, o interfere with study procedures, o make participation unsafe, or o make it hard to follow the study rules.
